source_excerpts.text:
EXACT STOCHASTIC COMPILATION FROM IMPERFECT EXPERIMENTS
Working construction, 2026-10-31

Scientific claim and scope
==========================
The main object is an executable probability program, not an estimate of its
unknown numerical constants. Independent experimental bits supply those
constants during execution. A rational probability calculation with controlled
RELATIVE derivatives can be compiled into an exactly distributed output bit.
The construction has polynomial expected experimental, fair-bit, and ordinary
bit-computation cost. In particular its cost does not contain the reciprocal
of the output probability or of an intermediate positive partition function.

Existence of Bernoulli factories, smooth Bernstein envelopes, reverse-time
Bernstein algorithms, and Bernoulli races are established machinery. The
candidate new component here is a COMPUTATION-CHARGED multivariate lifting:
replace an exponentially large hypergeometric coefficient sum by a bounded,
nonnegative randomized correction, using a fixed-order Taylor control and a
tractable sum of product envelopes. Relative scale prevents rare outputs from
turning this correction into a rare rejection event. Third-order envelopes
pay for exact integer arithmetic, not only for input tosses.

The very strong conventional route is developed separately in
../broad_control/SHIFTED_REJECTION_PROOF.txt. Coarse positive proposals,
logarithmic coin factories, shifted exponential races, and capped relearning
already give the exact positive-factor endpoint, and extend to positive
arithmetic circuits and other models with an executable positive monomial
sampler. That route is ADOPTED, not claimed as a separation. The theorem below
does not require such a sampler or positive circuit representation. Its
arithmetic procedure may use subtraction. No priority claim is made for the
whole theorem; the literature comparison establishes the particular missing
operation investigated, not exhaustive novelty.

This is a theoretical construction with conservative polynomial constants.
The supplied programs verify the exact finite correction and a complete toy
factory; they are not a practical large-scale implementation of the generic
bound. A separate acquisition construction and actual numerical consumers
below prevent a hidden learned-representation or numerical-solver oracle.

source_excerpts.text:
EXACT EXPERIMENTAL SAMPLING BY AN ADOPTED SHIFTED-REJECTION ROUTE

Status: constructive synthesis of established Bernoulli-factory components and
ordinary positive-weight sampling. This is a strong conventional comparator
for the proposed broader Astra exactification compiler. It covers bounded-width
positive factor models and monotone positive arithmetic circuits. It does not
establish a generic compiler for signed arithmetic formulas whose resulting
polynomials happen to have nonnegative coefficients.

Primary components:
[DHK N] Dughmi, Hartline, Kleinberg, Niazadeh, Bernoulli Factories and Black-Box
Reductions in Mechanism Design, STOC 2017 / JACM 2021, arXiv:1703.04143.
Author manuscript: https://www.cs.cornell.edu/~rdk/papers/stoc17-rad.pdf
The empirical-maximum-in-expectation shift and exponential Bernoulli race are
established machinery. The key is that the shift coin's MEAN, not every noisy
empirical realization, has the deterministic required approximation property.
[Huber] Nearly optimal Bernoulli factories for linear functions, CPC 2016,
arXiv:1308.1562; https://arxiv.org/pdf/1308.1562 .
For input coin bias b, known c>1 and cb<=1-epsilon, the constructive scalar
factory uses <=9.5 c/epsilon input flips in expectation. Its simple algorithm
is implemented in shifted_rejection_demo.py; it is not an unknown solver.

1. Contract

There are M labelled primitive Bernoulli experiments with unknown fixed biases
p_i in [0,1]. Fresh chosen-label experiments are independent. Set
z_i=a+(1-a)p_i, where rational a in (0,1) is known. A later query has weights

    w(x)=L(x) product_{j=1}^m z_{i_j(x)},

where L(x) is a known zero-one constraint, and repeated factor occurrences are
allowed. Suppose the query's structural representation permits polynomial-time
exact sampling from the same weights with arbitrary supplied positive rational
numbers hat z_i. This numeric sampling routine must be constructed, not supplied
as an oracle. For bounded combined primal treewidth and fixed alphabet, ordinary
sum-product variable elimination with stored backward conditionals does this.
The combined constraint graph counts in the width. Finding a decomposition can
be paid using the earlier complete width search or a conventional FPT algorithm.
If L is infeasible, the rational sum-product computation detects that fact.

Knowledge of true scopes (or valid superscopes) is required
